annotations.rationale: The FY2025 Form 2-A reports the identical repdigit value 999,999 for three different current-quarter concepts (total throughput, forwardhaul throughput and gas of others received for transmission / delivered for others) in the same filing. The same filer's 2025 Q3 Form 3-Q reports a quarter throughput of 1,399,415 Dth and the same annual filing's year-to-date gas-account figures are 2,399,414 / 3,020,968 Dth, so the repeated 999,999 is inconsistent in magnitude and improbable as three independent measurements. It has the appearance of a placeholder, but FERC filed it as the value; it is preserved exactly as filed and flagged for human confirmation against the rendered p.520/p.521.
